title: Requirements V2 — CFF Field Form + Client Update Round (Aug 2026)
summary: Signed scope contract for the Aug 2026 round: full CFF field register, public/internal boundary, target data model, R-01–R-90 requirements, phased build plan.
notes: MANIFEST_TYPE=SPEC applied (authoritative). Section 3.1 explicitly supersedes prior decisions: (1) 'no price by design' in lib/db/schema.ts, CONTENT_MODEL.md and PROPERTY_DETAIL.sidebarNote is superseded by full price+charges capture gated by showPricePublicly (default false); (2) lib/categories.ts four-category taxonomy remains for intent but an orthogonal collection axis (Kothi/Plot/Projects/Flats/Land/Commercial) is added per R-04; (3) the flat mostly-public properties table in lib/db/schema.ts is split so owner, money, legal and status data move to internal-only sibling tables per section 4.1; (4) the single shared admin password in lib/admin/auth.ts is superseded by named admin users with roles and audit log per R-54. Document also carries product-requirement content (R-01–R-90 need/build/done-when), so PRD signals coexist with SPEC signals; manifest type takes precedence.
